description: This file implements the logic for managing logical channels, including QoS tracking, buffer status updates, and MAC SDU/CE allocations within a scheduler context for a wireless communication system.

classes.name: logical_channel_mapper
classes.description: Manages logical channel and logical channel group mappings, QoS tracking, and buffer status updates.

classes.name: logical_channel_system
classes.description: Main system managing UE logical channels, slices, and buffer statuses within the scheduler.

classes.name: ue_logical_channel_repository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing a specific UE's logical channels, including configuration and buffer management.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates bit rate estimates for all logical channels and groups at each slot indication.

methods.name: addmod_lc_and_lcg
methods.description: Adds or modifies logical channel and group entries, updating QoS tracking accordingly.

methods.name: rem_lc
methods.description: Removes a logical channel from the system, including QoS detachment.

methods.name: rem_lcg
methods.description: Removes a logical channel group from the system, including QoS detachment.

methods.name: register_lc_slice
methods.description: Associates a logical channel with a RAN slice.

methods.name: register_lcg_slice
methods.description: Associates a logical channel group with a RAN slice.

methods.name: deregister_lc_slice
methods.description: Removes association of a logical channel with a RAN slice.

methods.name: deregister_lcg_slice
methods.description: Removes association of a logical channel group with a RAN slice.

methods.name: last_dl_sched_bytes
methods.description: Returns pointer to last scheduled bytes for a logical channel.

methods.name: last_ul_sched_bytes
methods.description: Returns pointer to last scheduled bytes for a logical channel group.

methods.name: ul_sched_bytes_accum
methods.description: Returns pointer to accumulated scheduled bytes for a logical channel group.

methods.name: avg_dl_bits_per_slot
methods.description: Calculates average downlink bits per slot for a logical channel.

methods.name: avg_ul_bits_per_slot
methods.description: Calculates average uplink bits per slot for a logical channel group.

methods.name: handle_dl_buffer_status_indication
methods.description: Updates buffer status and HOL time for a logical channel based on received indication.

methods.name: allocate_mac_sdu
methods.description: Allocates MAC SDU space for a logical channel, updating buffer status.

methods.name: allocate_mac_ce
methods.description: Allocates MAC control element space for a logical channel.

methods.name: build_dl_transport_block_info
methods.description: Builds transport block info with MAC SDUs and CEs for a specific slice.
